shortDescription: Manages power states of virtual machines in vCenter

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The datacenter where the VM you'd like to operate the power.

options.name: folder
options.description: Destination folder, absolute or relative path to find an existing guest. Should be the full folder path, with or without the 'datacenter/vm/' prefix For example 'datacenter_name/vm/path/to/folder' or 'path/to/folder'

options.name: folder_paths_are_absolute
options.description: If true, any folder path parameters are treated as absolute paths. If false, modules will try to intelligently determine if the path is absolute or relative. This option is useful when your environment has a complex folder structure. By default, modules will try to intelligently determine if the path is absolute or relative. They may mistakenly prepend the datacenter name or other folder names, and this option can be used to avoid this.

options.name: force
options.description: Ignore warnings and complete the actions. This parameter is useful while forcing virtual machine state.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: moid
options.description: Managed Object ID of the instance to manage if known, this is a unique identifier only within a single vCenter instance. This is required if O(name) or O(uuid) is not supplied.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to work with. Virtual machine names in vCenter are not necessarily unique, which may be problematic, see O(name_match). This is required if O(moid) or O(uuid) is not supplied.

options.name: name_match
options.description: If multiple virtual machines matching the name, use the first or last found.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: question_answers
options.description: A list of questions to answer, should one or more arise while waiting for the task to complete. Some common uses are to allow a cdrom to be changed even if locked, or to answer the question as to whether a VM was copied or moved. Can be used if O(state) is V(powered-on).

options.name: scheduled_at
options.description: Date and time in string format at which specified task needs to be performed. The required format for date and time - 'dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm'. Scheduling task requires vCenter server. A standalone ESXi server does not support this option.

options.name: scheduled_task_description
options.description: Description of scheduled task. Valid only if O(scheduled_at) is specified.

options.name: scheduled_task_enabled
options.description: Flag to indicate whether the scheduled task is enabled or disabled.

options.name: scheduled_task_name
options.description: Name of scheduled task. Valid only if O(scheduled_at) is specified.

options.name: state
options.description: Set the state of the virtual machine.

options.name: timeout
options.description: If this argument is set to a positive integer, the module will wait for the VM to reach the poweredoff state. The value sets a timeout in seconds for the module to wait for the state change. This value is ignored if the desired state is V(reboot-guest).

options.name: use_instance_uuid
options.description: Whether to use the VMware instance UUID rather than the BIOS UUID.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the instance to manage if known, this is VMware's unique identifier. This is required if O(name) or O(moid) is not supplied.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
